items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 82:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the diminishing of the moon? Here, the first time that the Partzuf of the Nukva was corrected, which was on the fourth day of the days of Genesis, when they ascended as MAN to the palace of Aba and Ima and received there the Mochin of the AB of the Mazal — ZA was included in Aba and the Nukva was included in Ima — they were then, in the secret of the verse “the two great luminaries”, of completely equal stature one to the other, for the Nukva received the Mochin of Ima, like ZA received the Mochin of Aba, and they became equal to one another, like Aba and Ima themselves. However, after they descended from there and came to their place, the Nukva was unable to stand in these Mochin that she had received from the NHY of Ima above, because the Hochma and Hesed within them were taken by ZA, and the Nukva received from them only the aspect of the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, which are the aspect of Hochma without Hassadim, like Ima of the AB of the Mazal herself. And Ima herself can stand in those Mochin, for the light of Ein Sof clothes in Ima only in Hochma alone, and she does not need a garment of Hassadim upon the light of Hochma. Not so the Nukva: the light of Hochma cannot clothe in her without a garment of Hassadim, because ZON are in their essence only the aspect of Hassadim, and of Hochma there is nothing in them, from their root in the worlds, but the aspect of illumination within their Hassadim. And therefore, at the time that she lacks Hassadim, also the light of Hochma cannot clothe in her. And therefore the moon complained: “two kings cannot use one crown”, for she could not stand in these great Mochin, equal to the AB of ZA, because of the lack of Hassadim, as above. And then it was said to her: “go and diminish yourself”, namely that she should return to the aspect of the point under the Yesod of ZA, so that she would receive the Mochin from the coupling made in the head of ZA upon the Malchut of Ima, for from this coupling Hochma is received by its clothing within the Hassadim, and then she can stand in these Mochin. As above in Answer 7. See there. And this matter is called “the diminishing of the moon”, because after she grew to a stature equal to ZA from his back, she returned and diminished down to the point under the Yesod of ZA. And know that this is the root of all the diminishings made in the Nukva after the completion of the building of her Partzuf from the back of ZA. For so it is always: after her receiving of the Aba and Ima of the back, she returns to the point under the Yesod of ZA and receives the Aba and Ima of the face-to-face. (Item 17).
